changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attendance_regularization r SET requested_by_id = ( SELECT e.id FROM employee e WHERE e.employee_name = r.requested_by AND e.organization_id = r.organization_id ) WHERE r.requested_by_id IS NULL AND r.requested_by IS NOT NULL AND r.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e WHERE e.employee_name = r.requested_by AND e.organization_id = r.organization_id ) = 1

changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attendance_regularization r SET approved_by_id = ( SELECT e.id FROM employee e WHERE e.employee_name = r.approved_by AND e.organization_id = r.organization_id ) WHERE r.approved_by_id IS NULL AND r.approved_by IS NOT NULL AND r.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e WHERE e.employee_name = r.approved_by AND e.organization_id = r.organization_id ) = 1
